_readme: Every input to analysis/market_model.py. 'sourced' values cite data/sources.md; 'assumption' values are analyst judgement and are stress-tested in the sensitivity analysis.

fx_idr_per_usd.note: Close to the Rp17,320 used by Bisnis.com in May 2026; update before use.

women_15_34_m.source: BPS population projection 2025 by age & sex (15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34)

men_15_34_m.source: BPS population projection 2025 by age & sex (15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34)

women_any_use.source: Jakpat Beauty Trends 2024: 75% of women use sunscreen

men_any_use.source: Jakpat Beauty Trends 2024: 42% of men use sunscreen

women_daily_use.source: Snapcart survey: 35% of Indonesian women apply sunscreen daily

units_per_daily_user.note: 30-50 ml units per year; recommended dose would imply more, real usage is lighter

avg_realised_price_idr.note: Average paid per unit across all tiers after vouchers and multi-packs; observed hero SKUs Rp47k-123k per unit, long tail much cheaper

age_35_plus_uplift.note: Spend from users aged 35+ as a share on top of the 15-34 core

ecom_sunscreen_h1_2024_idr_bn.source: Compas via Gizmologi: sunscreen e-commerce sales Rp914bn in H1 2024

ecom_sunscreen_h2_2023_idr_bn.source: Compas via Gizmologi: Rp530bn in H2 2023

ecom_growth_2025_2026.note: Annual growth of e-commerce sunscreen sales after the 2024 surge; beauty e-commerce grew strongly per Compas

ecom_share_of_purchases.source: Jakpat Premium Report as cited in Undip thesis: e-commerce = 68% of skincare purchases

java_share.source: BPS SUPAS 2025: 55.65% of population lives on Java

premium_mass_tier_share.note: Share of sunscreen value sold at Rp80k-130k per unit

som_share_of_sam.note: Year-3 share. Benchmark: the #4 brand (Skintific) holds ~5.2% of all e-commerce sunscreen sales
